subject: Computer Vision Leaders Dinner Seattle - 29 May
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about what you're building for autonomous cargo delivery
so I thought to reach out with an invite from our founder [SENDER]. He is
hosting an intimate dinner for AI leaders in Seattle on Thursday May 29th.
We'd love for you to join if you're available.

We've reserved a private dining room for 30 guests at Aerlume from 6:30 to
9:30 pm. Attendees include Heads of AI and computer vision leads from
Latitude AI, Brinc Drones and Carbon Robotics.

development platform built to accelerate model development. We work with
over 200 AI teams including Woven by Toyota, Mobileye and Wayve.

Happy to share more details if you can join!

Heard great things about your work at UncannyVision / EEN from Tijmen Vos
and Hari Surendranath at ISC West. Wanted to reach out since we work with
Milestone Systems, Rhombus Systems and LiveView Technologies on similar
computer vision models for physical security. Thought it might be a good
time to connect.

For context.. We help over 200 AI teams accelerate their model development
by consolidating large-scale video data curation, annotation, workflow
automation and model eval in one platform.

Given your extensive experience in scaling computer vision solutions, I'd
love to get your candid feedback on what we've built. Let me know if you're
open for a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?

subject: Plan for CVPR
text:
Hi [NAME],

Assuming you and [COMPANY] team will be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee & show the team some of the big improvements to the product since we last chatted to see if they might align with what [COMPANY] is doing on all things computer vision.

We are also hosting an AI/ML happy hour on Friday - you'd be more than welcome to join & share with whoever - let me know if you'd like more info on this & I can share the link,
